title: Remi
tagline: Remi is an AI-powered finance agent that helps users seamlessly manage their funds, optimize bill payments, and avoid penalties—all while leveraging Web3 assets.
description:
🔗 Unified Finance Management – Connects with Plaid to fetch all bank and credit card transactions and integrates with Web3 wallets to track crypto holdings.

💰 Real-Time Spending Insights – Provides available-to-spend balance by considering upcoming bills, incoming payments, and cash flow trends.

⚡ Automated Bill Payments – Ensures timely payments using the best available payment instrument while maximizing offers and cashback.

🏦 Smart Liquidity Solutions – If running low on cash, Remi helps secure low-interest collateralized loans against crypto to cover urgent expenses.

📈 Credit Score Optimization – Avoids missed payments, reduces penalties and interest rates, and helps boost your credit score.
how_its_made:
The product fetches financial data from plaid and uses agents for bill payment, obtaining loans and day-to-day assistance.
- Plaid for fiat Financial data
- AgentKit / Coinbase developer SDK for interactions
- Base wallets with Agent interface
- Privy wallet connectors and server wallet
